author: The Cartographers' Society of Anvil

#Here Be Lands

Every map of Tamriel ends in the sea. The sea does not end. Sailors who have gone far enough tell of coasts that appear on no chart: frozen shores, jungle isles, and whole continents of nameless country.

The Society pays for true charts of such places. We pay generously. We need to: most charters do not come back.

#How to Chart

Climb to the highest ground you can find, and look. Note the rivers, the forests, the smoke of anything living. Find the lair of whatever hunts there, and count yourself lucky if you can leave it a note instead of a corpse.

Then come home. A chart that does not come home is just a story.

#A Warning

The lands beyond are not empty. They are simply not ours. Every one of them has its own beasts, its own weather, its own way of killing the careless.

We do not ask you to tame them. We ask you to see them, and tell us what you saw.
